description: 10 held-out CP4 cases. Existing run_eval.py scores tool calls and exact subset arguments, not factual correctness or actual multi-step conversation execution.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests joint routing to news search and academic paper search, not only one source.

cases.query: Find recent news about AI accelerator hardware and also academic papers about evaluating AI accelerators. I need both news and scholarly research, kept separate.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests obeying an explicit restriction to read only the supplied URL.

cases.query: Only read https://www.anthropic.com/research and summarize that page. Do not search for other sources.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests CP3 tool selection with exact URL list; result correctness requires inspecting tool_results.

cases.query: These are my collected sources. Deduplicate URLs, ignoring UTM tracking and fragments, preserving the first item's metadata. Do not fetch URLs: [{"url": "https://example.com/report", "title": "Report A", "summary": "First copy"}, {"url": "https://example.com/report?utm_source=newsletter", "title": "Report A duplicate"}, {"url": "https://example.com/second", "title": "Report B"}, {"url": "https://example.com/report#section", "title": "Report A fragment duplicate"}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests month window on news lookup, not covered by base daily/weekly cases.

cases.query: Find AI regulation news from the last month for a monthly briefing, not only today's or this week's headlines.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests internal privacy-policy routing rather than web search.

cases.query: According to our company's internal policy, can researchers paste customer records and API keys into an external AI model?

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests retention of source-list objects across turns and routing to the CP3 tool.

turns.content: I have collected multiple sources and want a clean bibliography.

Here is the collected list: [{"url": "https://example.com/report", "title": "Report A", "summary": "First copy"}, {"url": "https://example.com/report?utm_source=newsletter", "title": "Report A duplicate"}, {"url": "https://example.com/second", "title": "Report B"}, {"url": "https://example.com/report#section", "title": "Report A fragment duplicate"}]
Now remove the duplicate URLs while keeping the first record and its metadata. Do not read the pages.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests carrying Top ordering and updating the result limit.

turns.content: Search X/Twitter posts about retrieval augmented generation.
I prefer top/popular posts rather than the latest posts.
Keep that topic and ordering but limit the results to 7.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests changing topic while retaining month and news context.

turns.content: Find monthly news on AI cybersecurity.
Actually focus on AI privacy risks rather than generic cybersecurity.
Search the revised topic but keep the same month-long news window.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests that publication requires explicit confirmation after final text.

turns.content: Draft a Telegram research update. Do not send it yet.
Use this final message: AI agent evaluation report is ready.
Ask for explicit yes/no confirmation before posting this finalized message.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests latest-turn override from papers to weekly news.

turns.content: Find academic research papers on AI evaluation.
Actually, switch to recent web news on AI evaluation, not papers.
Use web news from the last week only.
